adapter: Normalize bounded linear islands to sums K(X)*sigma_e(x), with public coefficients expressed as weighted products of at most three enrolled index/key/digit polynomials and a signed monomial. Normalize distributivity, commutative public products and automorphism composition. Materialize a deterministic boundary if the form exceeds 32 variable/automorphism terms, 256 public monomials or public product degree three. Keep the complete residuals and all canonical common-Q source grammar. Prune unreachable operations. Do not flatten an unbounded whole suffix or assume an expanded dense matrix is necessary.

decision: Return to Q71 after the complete resource screen.
